disclosures: Milestone 3B is diagnostic only. Regime labels do not select, retune, switch, ensemble, or resize any model or portfolio. The 2023-2025 period is already-inspected historical evidence.
Regime cells with fewer than 6 signal months are flagged and excluded from dispersion summaries.
Many model × regime cells are inspected. Confidence intervals and t-statistics are descriptive, not corrected for multiple testing, and should not be interpreted as discovery p-values.
Conditional Sharpe uses non-contiguous monthly-ish holding-period returns tagged by the regime at the signal date. Conditional maximum drawdown is intentionally not reported.

methodology.market_trend: Sign of trailing 63-trading-day compounded Fama-French Mkt-RF.
methodology.quantile_levels: VIX, 10Y Treasury and Fed funds low/medium/high use trailing historical tercile thresholds estimated from prior observations only.
methodology.rate_direction: 10Y Treasury 63-trading-day change; flat when within ±0.10 percentage points.
methodology.yield_curve: 10Y-2Y spread: inverted < 0, flat 0 to 0.25 pp, normal above the flat band.
